title: Multi-block scan with block-sum carry (CUDA)
info: Real CUDA-C compiled by arena.cuda_c.CudaProgram, executed on arena.cuda_sim.GPU.
128 elements = 4 blocks of 32 (one warp each); the same kernel is launched 3 times (phase 0, 1, 2), since no single launch can globally synchronize across blocks.
block_sums must hold each block's EXCLUSIVE carry (sum of every block strictly before it) after phase 1, not an inclusive scan of the block totals.
